context: A uni student gives a teen friend pep-talk over coffee
purpose: Teach: 瞳/斜め/今頃/抱く/癒さ/つくづく/到底/ツボ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、今日はつくづく嫌になっちゃって…テストもバイトも、もう到底無理かも。
lines.en: Senpai, I'm just deeply fed up today... tests and my part-time job, I really can't handle it anymore.
lines.style: Teen girl venting, voice trailing into a sigh.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おっ、その斜め前の席、空いてるよ。座って座って、コーヒーおごるから。
lines.en: Oh, that seat diagonally in front is empty. Sit down, sit down, I'll buy you a coffee.
lines.style: Warm older brother tone, gentle and inviting.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう…ここのカフェ来ると、ほんと心が癒されるんだよね。
lines.en: Thanks... whenever I come to this cafe, my heart really gets healed.
lines.style: Soft, slightly weary teenage voice, almost whispered.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかるよ。俺も一年の今頃、同じこと思ってた。瞳の奥が死んでたもん、毎日。
lines.en: I get it. Around this time in my first year, I felt the exact same way. The depths of my eyes looked dead every single day.
lines.style: Reflective, casual male voice with a small chuckle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩でも?信じられない。いつも余裕そうなのに。
lines.en: Even you, senpai? I can't believe it. You always seem so composed.
lines.style: Surprised teen voice, eyes widening slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いやいや、つくづく感じるんだけどさ、夢を抱く時期って一番しんどいんだよ。
lines.en: No no, I really feel this deeply — the period when you're holding onto a dream is the hardest.
lines.style: Earnest, lowered voice, leaning forward over the table.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夢かぁ…私、今頃そんなの語る資格あるのかな。
lines.en: A dream, huh... do I even have the right to talk about something like that right now?
lines.style: Hesitant, looking down into the coffee cup.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あるある。あ、見て、あの店員さんの転び方、笑いのツボすぎるんだけど。
lines.en: Of course you do. Oh, look — the way that staff member just tripped totally hits my funny bone.
lines.style: Bright pivot to teasing tone, suppressing laughter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと先輩!でも…ありがと、なんかちょっと元気出た。
lines.en: Hey, senpai! But... thanks, I feel a little bit better now.
lines.style: Half-laughing, half-scolding, voice lifting at the end.
